content.description:
Express yourself and earn passive income in ADA with Cardamojis, the emojis used in DeSend, a decentralized messaging app on the Cardano blockchain!

Cardamojis are the emojis used in DeSend, a decentralized messaging app on the Cardano blockchain that puts user security and privacy first. Owning a Cardamoji NFT lets you earn passive income in ADA every time someone uses your emoji in the app! Send, receive, request and store ADA inside DeSend and message your friends and family across all of your devices – phones, tablets and desktop included.
